tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub sde bsam gtan chos mchog gling gi bca' yig yod/

oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bder gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi ngo bo nyid// ston pa shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang*// gnyis med chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan karma pa// bdud las rnam par rgyal de'i zhabs pad spyi bos mchod// gang gi ring lugs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyon yangs por// zla med sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang nyin mor byed pa'i dbang*// skye dgu'i log rtog sgrib pa'i mun pa mthar bskrad nas// rang byung ye shes de nyid mchog gi pad tshal rgyas// skal ba dang ldan gdul bya'i ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs// yang dag dam chos bdud rtsi'i dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa lam yon tan rab rdzogs rnam par dag pa'i lam zhugs nas// 'og min zhing gi bdag po sku bzhi'i dbang phyug gi /go 'phang dam pa 'dod pa'i ma rgan sems can srid mtshor bying ba kun// zhen log nges 'byung mos gus dad pa'i lhag bsam gru rdzings la brten nas// byams pa dang ni snying rje chen po'i skya bas yang yang nyer bskul te// bde chen thar pa'i gling du don gnyis rin chen sgrub rnams 'dir dengs shig /de yang rang re rnams thob par dka' ba'i dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ldan gyi mi lus rten bzang 'di nyid thob nas 7ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/ yongs 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa dpal karma pa bdud 'dul rdo rje sogs mtshan dang ldan pa'i bla ma dang mjal/ chos phyag rgya chen po bka' brgyud yongs kyi grub pa'i mchog brnyes pa'i lam bzang por zhugs pa'i dus 'dir/ sgrub brgyud kyi sngar srol bzang po'i rgyun nyams med kyi phyir/ srin po zhes pa shing yos gnam lo spyod pa'i dus phun sum tshogs par yang dben bsam gtan chos mchog gling zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang nyid legs par grub nas/ de dag tu bsti ba'i rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pa kun spangs rtogs ldan rnams kyi thugs la 'dogs rgyur/

de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa zhes pa dam pa'i chos yang dag gi rgyun dang*/ de nyams su len pa la zer ba'i bstan rgyun yang dag cig byung na rtag tu rang gzhan gyi dge legs 'phel bar nges phyir/ sngon gyi skyes mchog dam pa dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bka' brgyud 'chang ba chen po 7grub mchog karma pak+shi la sogs pa'i phyag srol nyams pa med par skyong ba'i lugs kyi nges don phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba ma 'khrul ba nyid 'khor lo gsum pa'i dgongs don gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i tshul dang mthun par 'dzin cing*/ snga 'gyur 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa zung 'jug tu thugs kyi dpal be'ur 'khyil ba dang*/ deng dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi mthar thug pa'i dbang gis bdud las su gyur pas gsang sngags dgongs pa log par spyad de/ brgyud par bstan pa tshad mar zhugs par rlom yang*/ de tshul bzhin mi spyod pa'i gang zag zog po dam nyams 'dres khyer sogs skyon can rigs dang*/ chos rang bzo'i 'khyog bcos bslad bcug gter log gter rdzun sogs chos min chos ltar bcos nas bslu brid kyi blo gros can kha cig snang yang*/ 'di dag rang rkang du spyod na rang gzhan kun gyi gnas skabs mthar thug gi bde legs 'grib cing nyes tshogs ma lus pa bskyed par 'gyur ba lta ci smos// cung zad tsam rang rang las snang du chos la bslad dang grib kyi shan phog na/ dkon mchog bstan pa'i sel chen por 'gyur ba dang*/ yul khams rnams kyang 'phral phug kun tu mi shis pa kho nar 'gyur la/ des na gnas skabs grub mtha' sangs rgyas par 'dzin cing mdo sngags kyi gzhung la thos bsam sgom pa ltar snang bar 'bad kyang nges shes sogs thugs nas ma 'khrungs/ de'i dgongs don mtha' dag ji bzhin ma go ba'i skyon gyis/ lam log 'dra min nor so can ltung pa la'ang rnam dag yin pa'i khul du 'khrul nas der zhugs pa'i rigs yong bas/

de 'drar ma song ba dgos shing*/ tshe 'di'i 'dun ma phran bu la'ang legs nyes kyi dpyad pa du mas gtan la 'bebs dgos na tshe rabs gtan bde'i 'dun ma don du gnyer ba la gnad don ma 'khrul par nyes skyon rdul tsam dang bral ba'i chos dang brgyud pa bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin legs par brtags pa gzhir bcas pa nas dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du sdom pa dam tshig tshul ldan gyi sgo nas bsrung*/ bskyed rim bzlas brjod sems ngo blta ba sogs nyams len la brtson pa cher bzhes nas/ de yang chos spyod kyi rtsa ba so thar gyi sdom pa spyi dang ldan pa/ rtsa ba bzhi chang dang lnga spang dgos tshul gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sogs ji bzhin par bsrung ba'i 'dul khrims sogs su gsal ltar las zhu dgos 'ga' zhig ma mchis rung*/ spang blang gi rim pa mdor bsdus shig zhu na/ srog bcad pas ni dmyal bar skye zhing*/ de yi rtsa ba zhe sdang drag po'i dbang las byung ste/ de yang bskal pa stong gi dge ba yang*// khong khro gcig gis med par byed// gsungs pa dang*/ ma byin len gyi rnam smin yi dwags su skye zhing sdug bsngal bzod med myong*/ de yang rgyal ba'i gsung las/ mi gang gzhan gyi nor la ma byin len// de yis ngan song sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// de nas mi yi srid pa 'dir 'ongs kyang*// phongs shing gzi brjid chung la mya ngan 'gyur// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/ 'dod log chags sred dbang gis mi tshangs bar spyod pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rgyal bas/ gang zhig gzhan gyi bud med der 'gro ba// lcags kyi shal mar tsher ma rnon po yis// 'bigs par byed cing sdug bsngal de yis gdung*// de las thar kyang chung ma mi bsrun 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rdzun dang phra ma'i rnam par smin pas dmyal bar ltung shing*/ de yang thub pa'i zhal nas/ mi gang tshig ni shin tu mi sdom pa// rdzun dang tshig rtsub ngag 'chal phra ma rnams// smra mkhas de dag mi bzad dmyal bar ltung*// 'bar ba'i phur pa rnams kyis lce brgyangs shing*// thong gshol 'bar ba lnga brgyas rmo bar byed// kha cig spu gris bcad de rang nyid za// gzhan dag ro nye 'thung zhing kun tu 'bar// mi bzad skyabs med ngu zhing sdug bsngal 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

chang 'di nyes ltung thams cad kyi gzhi ma nyon mongs rgyas pa'i gnyen por 'dug pas/ rgyal ba'i zhal nas/ chang 'di btung na ngan pa spyod par 'gyur// rab tu 'jigs pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung*// dud 'gro'i gnas dang yi dwags dbul gyur pa// zhes dang*/ chang de nyung ngu 'thung kyang rnam par smin pa ni// mi yi gnas su skyes kyang tshul khrims lta ba nyams// gang gis btung yang mnar med 'bar bas bsreg par 'gro// yi dwags yul dang dud 'gro dman par gnas par 'gyur// tshul khrims nyams par 'gyur zhing gtam ngan mngon par 'bungs// ngo tsha med cing blo gros dri ma can du 'gyur// gang zhig 'thung na yon tan de dang de nyams 'gyur// zhes sogs gsung pa ltar dang*// 'on kyang de dag gi ltung bar gyur pa thams cad dngos su ma spyad kyang*/ yid kyis dran pa dang chags pa sogs nyes ltung shin tu che/ sems kyi mi dge ba spang ba'i yon tan yang*/ gang zhig yid kyi las rnams rab spangs na// lha mi'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa myong*// rnam dag lta bas 'jig rten dag byed cing*// rtag tu sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba'i las la gcig tu 'bad pa chen po bya ste/ phyogs ris med pa'i sems can 'bu srin phra'u yan gyi srog bskyab pa dang*/ lan dang rnam smin la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ gzhan 'khon du gyur pa'i mi mthun pa rnams mthun pa'i las byed pa dang*// bden pa dang drang pos zhi dal gyi 'jam por smra ba/ tshangs spyod yang dag pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ 'dod sems chung zhing nor la chog shes thob pa/ byams pa la sogs pa dang mi 'bral ba nas yang dag ba'i don la 'jug pa ste/ de dag kyang dang du len par bya ba 'os so// de dag gi 'bras bu'i yon tan dge bas ni/ 'di dang gtan gyi dge legs dam par spyod pa'i gzhi dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la bgrod pa'i lam stegs mchog tu 'gyur ro// de bzhin rang gis kyang dam chos tshul bzhin du spyod pa dang*/

gzhan la'ang spyad du bcug pa/ gzhan dag gi dge ba'i las la rjes su yi rang ba bya zhing sngar byas kyi sdig ltung thams cad gnyen po stobs bzhi'i sgo nas bshags pa dang*/ phyin chad de ltar mi bgyid pa'i dam bca' snying nas bzung*/ gzhan la'ang sdig ltung gi bya ba spyad du mi 'jug cing*/ sngon gyi nyes par 'gyod pa drag pos yul khyad par can gyi drung du bshags pa snying thag pa nas phul zhing*/ stong nyid bsgom pa dang*/ phung po gsum pa sogs mdo sde zab mo dang gzungs sngags kyi rigs kha ton du bya ba dang*/ sku gzugs mchod rten gsung rab bzhengs pa dang mchod pa sogs/ mdor na dkar po dge ba'i mthu yis mi dge ba'i myu gu gtan nas skems pa'i phyir sgo gsum dge ba'i phyogs la gnas par gyur na/ ston mchog thub dbang gi zhal nas/ gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa la// phyis nas bag dang ldan par gyur de yang*// zla ba sprin bral lta bu rnams mdzes te// dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin// zhes pa'i dgongs don ltar thugs la 'dogs par zhu ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa chen po rgyal dbang brgyad pa'i zhal snga nas/ gnyid sogs long skabs med med ltar byed nas// rgyun du rang sems nyid la 'dul sbyong gyis// sems can ma lus 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i// bsam pa dag pa yang du bskyed par gyis// dus dang rnam pa kun tu gzhan skyon mi rtog mi brjod/ long gtam mi bya/ tshe 'di'i 'brel chags mi bya/ dri rtog mi skyen/ ngo srung mi bya/ mthun 'jug spongs/ kha len re mos ma byed/ rang la ka cha med na sbyin bdag lta bu la bslangs nas/ sbyin bdag sangs rgyas thob pa'i slad du bsngo ba smon lam yang dag pa byed/ lto gang byung slong ba la dam bca'/ ma phyin ma 'dongs dogs spongs/ pha yul dang skyid sa la 'gro nas 'di 'dra byed/ mi yul dang sdug sa na mi 'gro ba'i chos byed bsam pa sogs log pa'i blo yin pas/

gar 'gro gar sdod kyang sprang po yin phyin gzhan bsgrub rgyu ci yod/ chos spyod bcu yi bya bas lus ngag dal bar skad cig kyang mi sdod pa 'di ka la blo rtse gtad pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la dug gsum mngon gyur ba nam byung dus gnyen po'i dpa' bskyed/ mdor na nyin zhag phrugs gcig la mdang de ring gi byed rgyu de las med snyam pa'i blo bde sang nge ba re byed dgos pa yin/ gnyid dang le lo byung dus shes pa de tshar gcod dgos pa yin zhes rje de nyid kyi bka' lung dri ma med pa dang*/ gzhan yang rgyal ba thams cad kyis sems can don du gsungs pa'i chos sgo mtha' yas pa thams cad don de lta bur lags pa'i phyir na thugs kyi pad+mor thim pa dang*/ gzhan 'phral dgos kyi kun spyod rigs 'di ga'i sngon gyi bca' yig chen mo ltar las gsar du zhu 'os ma mchis shing*/ da lam 'di ru rten 'brel gyi rdzas tsam las/ slad du mkhyen gnyis zab mo'i thugs dang ldan pa rnams kyis 'bel mchid bka' yi 'khor lo mtshungs pa med pa gnang ba gzhir bcas pa las/ ne tso'i klog 'don lta bu'i 'bras med kyi yi ge 'di bzhin dgos pas dben pa nas don ldan gyi tshig ris ma mchis rung*/ 'on kyang ston pa 'gran zla bral ba thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba stobs bcu mnga' ba 'jig rten gyi 'dren pa chen po bde bar gshegs pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya'i rgyal po thub pa'i dbang pos gsungs pa'i 'dul khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bslab bya la rtag tu brtson pa chen pos dang len nus par yod na/ rang re kun gyi 'di phyi tshe rabs kyi bde don sgrub pa'i dpal du gyur pa las/ 'jig rten skye bo mkhas grags dbang btsan rigs che nor phyugs kyi 'dod pa'i skal ba nyon mongs kyis bslad pa'i 'jig rten mi chos khrims kyi dbang gis rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi g.yo sgyus spyod pa ni 'di tshul ldan nam yang ma yin pas des na re zhig 'di bzhin sgrub sde pa rnams kyi nyer mkho'i gnas su gyur cing*/

tshul dang mi ldan pa'i spyod ngan sna tshogs kyis bstan pa'i sel zhugs/ rgyal khams kyi phan bde sgrib pa'i mdzad spyod 'di dang 'di zhes pa'i nyes pa rdul phra rab tsam yang gang su thad nas mi bsgrub par ci nas zhu lags shing*/ gal srid mi mthun log par zhugs pa'i spyod pa phran bu tsam gyi snang ba shar tshe thugs sun gnas dbyung sogs dam pa'i chos khrims 'gyur ba med pa'i sgo nas gang la gang 'tshams kyi bya ba drag po tshig tsam ma yin pa gting nas bsgrub rgyu lags pas/ de bzhin mthun 'jug rgya gang che gnang thub zhu ba lags na re 'bras don smin du gnang bar mdzod cig /ces bca' yig mdor bsdus su bkod pa 'di/ me 'brug gnam lor spyod pa'i dbo zla'i dmar phyogs bzang po la kwan ting tā'i si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang po zhes pas thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi rig grol bslab ldan 'dus pa'i dbus nas bris pa dge legs 'phel// sarba maṅga lam/// / ༈ oṃ swasti/ ma lus rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur pa// rang snang ye shes sku dang zhing khams la// dbang bsgyur rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs pad+mo// byang chub snying po'i bar du rtag par mchod// phra rags rtog tshogs dbyings su thim pa yi// yon tan grub pa mchog brnyes ti li pa// dka' thub mthar phyin paṇa chen nā ro dang*// dgyes mdzad rdo rje dngos snang lo tsā che// grub pa'i spyi mes rnal 'byor mi la ras// rgyal bas lung bstan zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhabs// de las bskal bzang drug pa'i rnam rol pa// dpal ldan karma pa sogs rim brgyud nas// don dam rtogs pa'i bka' babs kaṃ tshang gi /ring lugs rin chen gser gyi phreng mdzes pa'i// gnas lugs chos skur ston pa'i sgrub brgyud rnams// mi shigs thig le'i rgyun du gus pas 'dud// ces mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ li yul lcang ra smug po zhes gdod nas rang bzhin grub pa 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang*/

sngon tshe gu ru nyi ma 'od zer dang*/ pha cig dam pa rgya gar ba la sogs pa grub pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa yongs kyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin bzhin ngang gis 'du ba rtogs ldan slob brgyud chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'byung ba'i bsti gnas ga la ba der/ 7 thub bstan chos kyi 'khor lo gsang sngags dga' tshal gling zhes rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyis chags bcags shing*/ nges don ring lugs kyi srol btod pa'i gdan sa mchog la slar yang snying po'i bstan pa sgrub pa dang*/ bstan 'gror phan bde'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i thabs tshul la lhag blo thun min gyis drangs te/ drung sprul mchog nas de tshul la dge ba'i rnam dkar bgyi 'os rlabs su che zhing*/ gnad du gang 'gro 'dren mchog dpa' bo rin po che'i drung bka' brtag zhus skabs/ smug po'i sa dmigs su sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs bstan pa'i btsas dang yul gyi bde skyid 'phral yun kun tu shis pa'i bka' stsal phebs par brten/ de ltar bsgrub par brtsams pa'i skabs dbye ba na/ nyams len gyi sgom grwa gsar 'dzugs la bcos min gyi mos gus dang*/ dad pa gsum gyis rgyud grol nas lhag pa'i blo yi spobs pa dge ba/ gtsug lag zung gi gnas la bsod nams kyi rgya mtsho gting zab la dkyel che ba tshong dpon bsod nams phun tshogs zhes dge bcus mngon par phyug pa'i khyim bdag ngang tshul bzang po'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa gang des/ sgyu ma'i nor la snying po len phyir dngos po'i bdog pa longs spyod kyi btang ba phun sum tshogs pa gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i dpal las nye bar grub pa'i gtsug lag dri gtsang khang dang*/ gzhan yang dben khang 'ga' zhig dang bcas bkod legs khyad par 'phags pa mngon par 'du byas shing*/ de'i nang rten du rgyal ba'i sku brnyan bris 'bur bzhengs pa dang*/

mchod pa'i thebs su'ang dngul bre chen mang pos bslus pa'i zhing sa dang*/ de dag la brtse ba'i spyan rgyang gi gzigs pa mtshungs zla dang bral ba/ skyabs mgon rgyal mchog bcu bzhi pa'i drung nas rten gtso dang mchod theb/ 'di nas kyang 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i sku brnyan 'phags yul shar li 'khrul med byin gzi 'od 'bar can dang*/ rin chen gnyis pa srang 'khor lnga bcu tham pa/ rje btsun dpa' bo mchog nas kyang de bzhin gyi nang rten khyad 'phags dang*/ mchod theb kyi dngos po gya nom pa bcas bstsal zhing*/ rgyal sras thu bo drung pa sprul skus gtsos stod smad kyi bla sprul las byed 'dus sde rnams dang*/ rgyal po rgyal phran khyim bdag la sogs pa mchog dman kun nas kyang yon sbyor ba bcas deng nas bzung ji srid gnas kyi bar du sgrub pa'i grwa sde btsugs pa'i legs byas kyi rang gzugs bstar pa la re zhig spang blang gi tshul rnams mdor bsdus te bca' yig bkod pa la/ de yang rang re rnams sngon bsags dge ba'i goms stobs kyis skye dka' ba lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes shing*/ dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i rnyed par dka' ba mi'i lus rten thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i mtshan ldan gyi bla mas rjes su 'dzin/ 'phrad par dka' ba dam pa'i chos zab mo thob pa'i dal rten rin po che 'di'i khongs nas gtan gyi 'dun ma bsgrub pa la/ dang po zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs bzhin/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad mi rtag sgyu ma'i rang bzhin snying pos dben pa la blo ldog nas/ mos gus sgom gyi mgo bo zhes mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rtse gcig pa'i mos blos bcos min shugs 'byung gdung shugs kyi gsol 'debs dad pas khams gso nus pa/ mched grogs rdo rje spun rnams la'ang dag snang phyogs med 'byong zhing*/ 'jig rten 'khor ba'i sems can pha mar ma gyur pa med bzhin pa'i nye ring phyogs lhung dgra gnyen spangs te/

byams dang snying rje'i ngang la rtag par gnas bzhin/ dang por gzhi sdom pa gsum gyi sgor zhugs nas de dag gi bslab pa dang ldan par byas nas/ lam bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la rtag 'grus kyi rkang tshugs pa'i/ phyag rgya chen po'i sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa rnams dang*/ khyad par zab lam nā ro chos drug ces rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du grub thob nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon pa de dag gi zhal nas snyan du bka' rim par brgyud pa'i pha chos mthar thug snying po'i yang snying*/ nges pa don gyi ti la ka gsang ba chen po'i chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang 'byor ba'i tshul rnams rim par yongs 'dzin bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gus pas mchod par byas nas smin byed dbang dang grol byed khrid kyi gdams pas rang rgyud brlan par byas la/ de'ang dam tshig mig 'bras ltar bsrung pa las/ gsang sngags ni bka' gnyan phyir gang byung 'chol ba spyod na chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi chad pas 'di gtan gyi rtsa ba brlag par 'gyur bas des na bag yod gces spras bya ba ni gnad kyi snying po'o// de nas rgyun spyod la thun drug gam bzhir bcad pa'i/ 7 rje ras pa chen po'i zhal nas/ nam gung rje la gsol ba thob// tho rangs srog rtsol rlung la 'bad// nam langs dug lnga'i bshags pa gyis// nyi shar snang ba rgya yis thob// nyin gung chos spyod dge la 'bungs// dgong mor smon lam rgyas 'debs bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar yid la ci 'gror byed nas thor thun gti mug gnyid bslang gi brda btang ma thag sgo gsum tha mal du ma shor ba'i khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i sgom rim rnams mthar chags bton cing*/ nam gsal pa dang bstun gtor ma chu sbyin sogs btang*/ spro na bsang mchod bya/ nyi shar nas gung gi bar la'ang nyams len skyong zhing*/ thun bar der khams gseng dang chos spyod sāts+tsha btab pa/ dpe ltas la sogs gang 'os kyi spyod lam dang*/

gung nas phyed yol bar yang 'khrul 'khor sogs nyams len dang*/ dgong mor chos skyong gi gtor 'bul sa lam bar chad sel phyir sla chos dang khral 'don du ma song bar gang zab 'bad cing*/ dgong thun la'ang nyams len skyong ba sogs nan tan dang*/ nyal khar gcod kyi lus sbyin dmigs pa dang ldan pas/ bdag 'dzin blos btang phung po gzan du bskyur// dbyings rig bsre zhing sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad// ces pa ltar 'bad cing*/ de nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ 'od gsal ldang 'jug sogs kyi nyams len dang ma bral bar bya ba ste de rnams 'phral dgos kyi skor rnams so// thun bar rnams su yang rnam g.yeng le lo'i dbang du mi btang zhing chos spyod bcus dus 'da' bar bya yi/ phan tshun rnams bsam gtan gyi tsher mar gyur ba'i tshig rtsub ngan smras g.yo sgyu la sogs mi mthun bya spyod ngan pa'i rigs che phra mtha' dag spang ci nus dang*/ lhag par nya stong gi gso sbyong la 'bad cing 'dul khrims legs par bsrung bar gyur na/ de las logs su 'di zhes smos ma dgos mod/ 'on kyang snyigs dus 'dir rags pa tsam las phra zhib rtog dpyod dka' na'ang ras su bor ba nam yang mi bya'o// sha chang la'ang ha cang bag med spyod pa spang zhing byin gyis brlabs nas bdud rtsir bsgyur ba sogs byas la spyod/ gzhan dag kyang dge ba'i las la bkol gang nus byed pa dang*/ rnam pa kun tu chu bo'i rgyun bzhin dran rdzi brtan po'i ngang nas rig pa'i rang ngo 'khrul med yengs med kyi ngang nas gnas lugs kyi don la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs khrid chen rnams kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin nyams su len par bya ba ni gdams pa'i yang snying bla na med pa'o// smras pa/ sngon byon rtogs pa don gyi ye shes la// mnga' brnyes grub pa mchog gi srol bzang po// ma smad deng 'dir nyams len byin rlabs kyi// bka' babs brgyud pa las byung lam zab mor// 'jug 'dod las 'phro can rnams 'dir gson la// gtan 'dun 'gyur med rnam kun mchog ldan gyi// go 'phang bde blag thob bo 'di spel dges// rtsa ba'i sbyin bdag gzhan yang 'brel lo cog

/tshe dpal dbang 'byor rang grol phyag rgya che'i// gnas lugs chos sku mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'ang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos gdams par bya ba'i chos so// sarba maṅga lam/ ka l+ya ṇa war+dha/ dza yan+tu/// / mgon khang chen mo'i sgrub pa rnams kyi 'don sgrig dang bca' yig yod/ ༈ oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ snang srid zil gnon pad+ma saṃ bha wa// dbyer med grub chen karma pak+shi dang*// bstan srung rdo rje ber can lcam dral la// gus pas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs// zhes ched du brjod nas/ mgon khang chen mo bdud dpung zil non gyi sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi zhal 'don la/ dang po/ tho rangs kyi thun la/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ brgyud 'debs bde chen rdo rje/ phag mo'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs dang po nyin las rgyun du mi dgos/ sngon 'gro btang*/ srung 'khor/ skyabs sems/ tshogs zhing sogs/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa dang zung 'jug skur ldang bcas/ phyag chen sngon 'gro'i go yang des chod/ de nas/ legs ldan srung 'khor bsnyen pa rnams dang dgug gzhug /zhal bstab sngags bsnyen/ byang phyogs dur khrod dang*/ ye shes dbyings mas thun gtor phyir 'bul/ gar zlog dang*/ lo tri'i thal rdeb byas la thun grol/ chab gtor rgyas pa'i tshig don 'bring por 'dus pas de dang de'i cha lag bton pas 'thus/ bsang btang la/ 'don cha gsar bkod nang 'gags 'dus rtsis kyis de tsam bya/ snga dro'i thun la/ mtshal ma gzhung bzhin/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ tshogs dang*/ gsang sngags nang gtor/ lha chen dpal bar sngags ring mthar/ rdo rje 'chang dngos ma yab yum/ bco lnga nyin rnam sras rgyas pa/ rgyun par rnam sras dang sngags bdag gtor 'bul bsdus pa re/ dam can rgyas pa/ srin mgon bsdus pa/ zhing skyong rgyas pa/ mkhar nag bsdus pa/ a phyi'i lhub gsol gtor chog dang*/ rdor gdan ma/ brag btsan bsdus pa/ thang lha dzaṃ gling byang phyogs ma/

mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ gzhi bdag dkar gtor btang*/ bstod pa gang drin ma sogs nas/ dam zhing bstod pa sogs/ bsnyen pa bya/ dgug gzhug 3dang*/ rtags bstod gnyis kyis gtor ma yar phul/ thun grol/ 'di skabs gzhan gyi gsol ka dang bskang ba 'don dgos yod na bton/ gung thun la/ gsol ka rgyas pa/ lha mo dang*/ dam zhing gsol ka /bskang ba rgyas pa dang 'bring po/ bskang thun tshar lnga/ lha mo'i bskang ba dang*/ 'khrugs bskang*/ tshe ring ma'i bskang ba/ bdag sgrub ma/ sngags ring gong 'og /bsnyen pa bcas/ dgug gzhug /'das byon ma yab yum bskul dang gter sar sogs/ gtor ma yar 'bul/ thun grol/ gzhan gyi gsol ka sogs dmigs bsal dgos na bya/ dgong thun la/ mtshal ma dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs 'don/ tshogs mi dgos/ gsang sngags nang gtor/ lha chen sngags ring mthar/ phyag bzhi yab yum dang*/ rnam sras/ sngags bdag /dam can/ srin mgon/ zhing skyong*/ mkhar nag bcas kyi sngags bsngos bya/ kun tu bzang dang*/ rdo rje mi 'gyur/ brag btsan rgyas pa/ thang lha dri za'i rgyal po// mkha' 'gro dang*/ gzhi bdag gtor ma btang*/ bstod pa bya/ dam zhing mi dgos/ gsol ka byin rlabs/ bstan srung mthar thug /lha mo'i gsol ka /bskang ba byin rlabs dang bsdus pa tshar gcig /bsnyen pa bya/ dgug gzhug3/ma dag ma/ gang zhig bla ma/ pho brang mkha' spyod/ rak+ṣa sa/ nyi ma nub phyogs mthar thun gtor phyir 'bul/ gar zlog dang*/ seng gdong ma/ trig khroṃ ma thal rdeb bcas/ chos kyi dbyings ma yab yum dang*/ lhag ma btang*/ mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ ma mgon bkra shis pa'i gzungs 3 dang*/ bar chad sel gzungs/ 3 smon lam bkra shis dang bcas bya'o// nyer dgu'i dus gtor rgyas pa la tshogs chen srol bzhin phyogs mtshungs dgos pa'i/ thor thun skabs nyin ltar dang 'dra zhing*/ snga thun la mngon rtogs rgyas pa nas gzhung bzhin gyi 'khor lnga rnams dang*/ mkhar nag /a phyi rgyas pa nas dkyus ltar gzhi bdag dkar gtor bcas dang*/

bstod pa rnams yongs rdzogs dang*/ bsnyen pa bya/ mthar 'gug gzhug 3 dang*/ ma dag ma/ rtags bstod gnyis bton la thun grol/ gung thun la gsol ka rnams dang bskang ba rgyas bsdus bcas sngar bzhin/ bsnyen pa dang mthar 'gug gzhug 3 /de nas rgya mtsho gling ma sogs las 'grigs kyi drag bskul rnams dang*/ gson cig ma dang*/ 'das byon ma yab yum bskul byas la thun grol/ dgong thun la mtshal ma bsdus pa nyin ltar gyi bsnyen pa dang*/ mthar 'gug gzhug 3 /gang zhig ma/ pho brang mkha' spyod/ rak+ṣa sa yab yum bskul dang*/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi dza brdung skabs/ thun gtor sngon 'bul rnams phyogs gcig phyir 'bul dgos/ gar zlog la sogs gzhung bzhin/ dngos grub len chog dang bkra shis bcas/ de nas/ phag mo'i tshogs byin rlabs bton la bla ma yi dam spyan 'dren gzhung ltar dang*/ rigs lnga mkha' 'gro bsdu tshig byed/ de phyin dkyus ltar tshogs phud 'bul/ tshogs rol dang zhabs brtan 'don/ lhag ma dang rjes chog bkra shis sogs mtha' rgyas bya'o// gnam gang nyin rgyun gyi 'don 'grigs ji lta ba dang*/ tshes gcig lta bur sgrub pa rnams brje len skabs snga 'tshogs bya ba'i thun bzhi ka sbrel nas 'don pa'i bdag sgrub ma'i mthar bsnyen pa dang*/ sngags ring rnams dang*/ dgug gzhug 3 /ma dag ma/ 'das byon ma yab yum/ gang zhig bla ma phyi nyin ltar dang*/ dngos grub len sngags brgya rtsa brgyad/ bkra shis pa'i gzungs/ bar chad sel gzungs rnams nyer gcig re bzla/ smon lam bkra shis lha bsang dang bcas 'grub par byas nas skabs 'dir lha rten mchod rdzas spyan gzigs la sogs chos khrims pas rtsis sprad len zhib cha tshad ldan dgos rgyu'i ma tshang ba 'tshab pa sogs srol gang yod dang*/ gsar bzhugs rnams kyis dgong thun nas bzung mtshams bsdam zhing*/ cha gsum btang la tho bslang*/ bsam 'grub ma 'don/ de nas/ mtshal ma bsdus pa nyin bzhin dgong thun dang phyogs mtshungs la khyad par brag btsan bsdus pa dang*/

gzhan rnams dkyus ltar/ bsnyen pa dang*/ 'gug gzhug 3 /ma dag ma/ gang zhig ma'i mthar thun gtor phyir phul/ dam zhing bskul pa mi 'don/ gar zlog la sogs gzhung ltar bya/ phyi nyin thor thun la/ tshig bdun ma dang*/ brgyud 'debs phag mo'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs sogs gong gsal bzhin mthar chags su bton pas khyab bo// tha skar can gyi dbang phyogs la dgu chung gi tshul du bstan pa'i spyi rim gtor nag par bu'i las sbyor bca' sgrub skor gyi phyag len sogs/ ༈ rje gong ma'i gsung rgyun zin tho ci lta ba dgos shing*/ rgyun gyi spyod lam mtshams dam par bcad nas mtshams g.yog ma gtogs gzhan 'gro sdod mi chog /lha mjal yong mkhan de mtshungs dgongs zhus 'dra ma gtogs 'ong mi chog pa'i bka' rgya dam par yod cing*/ rnam kun dam tshig brtan po'i ngang nas dpal ldan bla ma dang ye shes mgon po dbyer med pa'i nges shes 'dun pa ldan pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dmigs pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum sogs lus dang ngag yid dge la bskul ba'i sgo nas bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len gtsor bton pa'i lha bsgom sngags bzlas gdon bya'i go rim rnams dang*/ ḍā dril/ rol mo rnga tshig /rkang gling btang lags/ gtor ma dang mchod pa rnams bsham bkod gso bran 'bul ba la sogs phyag len mthong ba brgyud pa'i zhal rgyun ji bzhin lhag chad med pa zhig gis rang bzo byung rgyal du ma song ba dang*/ bag med kyi chang rag btung ba sogs mdor na spyod lam rtsing hral dbang gis gnyid dang le lo la sogs nyon mongs rags pa rnams spang ba gal che zhing*/ tshul dang mi ldan pa'i log par lta ba'i gnas su 'gyur srid na/ ye shes pa'i lha la 'dzin rtog mi mnga' yang*/ las dang 'jig rten srung ma rnams kyis legs nyes stang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod bka' yi chad pa 'bebs shing*/ las 'bras blang dor bslu med kyis mnar med gnas su ltung bar 'gyur bas des na bag yod pa'i rnal 'byor la brtson par bya'o// sngar rgyun sgrub pa gsum dang*/

shing sprel lor gsar bzhag gcig gi phogs chas rten sa zhing dang*/ khyad par mgon po'i bsnyen 'khor bcas gzims dpon bder gshegs pas ji srid brtan par bzhag pa'i dge des rgyal bstan dar zhing bstan 'dzin mchog rnams zhabs pad brtan pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde rgyas zhing lhag par de nyid sa dang lam gyi ye shes yon tan mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs nas kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur dang dbyer med mngon byang chub cing*/ ma gyur 'gro rnams rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du yongs su bsngo bas de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /ces si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos sa skyong zhes pa shing bya zla ba gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga la bkod pa sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
